description: Validate your Applitools API key and optional server URL. Searches for API key in .env, applitools.config.js/ts/cjs/mjs, and playwright.config.js/ts/cjs/mjs files.

apiKey.description: Optional API key to validate (will search config files if not provided)

serverUrl.description: Optional Applitools server URL (defaults to https://eyes.applitools.com)

setAsDefault.description: If true, save the validated API key and server URL as the default configuration in cache

workingDirectory.description: Working directory to search for .env and config files (optional, defaults to process.cwd())

workspaceRoot.description: Workspace root to search for .env and config files (optional, defaults to current directory)

name: eyes_verify_api_key
